scope: One ordinary decode or encode operation, valid declared pool handle, explicit normalized complete profiles and ordered target-slot availability. Admission does not perform any command or validate caller truth.
remaining: Source availability is not a feature-enable receipt; application must record actual extension, profile, queue and feature queries and chosen device configuration.
Execute both applicable positive Vulkan paths with a supported target backend and independent result/validation evidence; platform fallback is not a substitute.
Protected content, query-pool creation and lifetime/reset synchronization, full encode-feedback flag/data layout, rate control and codec bitstreams are outside this preflight.
Other maintenance1 cases, remaining auxiliary extensions, Vulkan SC L1/L2 and production media lifecycle remain open.
